---
title: "03 National connectivity analysis"
output: html_notebook
editor_options:
  chunk_output_type: console
---

Runs the national connectivity analysis. It builds a resistance surface
and movement-threshold network for every urban region, computes ECS at
the fixed 59, 99 and 512 m thresholds (see `02b_Movement_Thresholds.Rmd`),
then runs the threshold sweep, the models of relative ECS, the
sensitivity analyses and the results tables and figures.

Items produced here (the other manuscript figures and tables are
produced in `04_Results_Figures.Rmd` from the results saved by this
notebook):

| Manuscript item | Chunk | Output file in `figures/` |
|---|---|---|
| Table 2 | `results_table2_model_comparison` | `Table2_model_comparison_59m.csv` |
| Supplementary Table 5 | `results_supp_table5_sensitivity_summary` | `SuppTable5_sensitivity_summary.csv` |
| Supplementary Figure 2 | `sloss_spacing_gratia_draw`, `sloss_spacing_gratia_appraise` | `Fig_SLOSS_spacing_gratia_smooths.png`, `Fig_SLOSS_spacing_gratia_diagnostics.png` |

The national results (`national_loop`) and the movement-threshold sweep
(`threshold_sweep_loop`, `threshold_sweep_extend_loop`) are also produced
here and saved to `checkpoint_dir`.

Checkpointed and resumable: results are saved after every region to
`08_national_ecs_results.csv` in `checkpoint_dir`. If the notebook is
stopped and re-run, it loads the existing results and skips regions
already completed.

The `national_loop` chunk takes several hours to run in full. Most
regions take a few seconds; the largest conurbations dominate the total.

Per-region failures are expected and handled. A few small regions fail
for reasons internal to grainscape (undefined columns in GOC's summary
table for a one-link graph, no patches found, or an invalid internal S4
object for a very small patch mask), not because of
`build_region_resistance()` or `build_region_mpg()`. Each region is
wrapped in `tryCatch()`; failures are logged with their error message
and the loop moves on.

Regions are processed from smallest to largest by area, so results
accumulate quickly for the many small and medium regions, and the few
very expensive large conurbations are attempted last.

Loads the shared settings and packages, and sets up the figures folder and the `save_fig()` helper used by the plotting chunks.

```{r setup}
source(here::here("scripts", "00_setup.R"))

# Figures are written here as well as shown in the plot pane. The folder
# is in the project, not on the checkpoint drive, because these are small
# outputs that belong with the manuscript.
figures_dir <- here::here("figures")
dir.create(figures_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

save_fig <- function(plot_obj, name, width = 9, height = 6.5) {
  ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, paste0(name, ".png")),
         plot_obj, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
  invisible(plot_obj)
}
```

# Build a per-region resistance surface and MPG

No padding is added around the region boundary: the urban boundary is
the hard edge of the analysis. Movement thresholds are fixed at 59, 99
and 512 m.

```{r build_functions}
library(terra)
library(dplyr)
library(grainscape)
library(raster)
library(igraph)

build_region_resistance <- function(region_name) {
  region <- urban_regions_named |> filter(bua_name == region_name)
  if (nrow(region) == 0) {
    stop("No region named exactly '", region_name, "' — check bua_name spelling/variant.")
  }

  bbox <- st_bbox(region)
  bbox_sfc <- st_as_sfc(bbox)
  region_vect <- vect(region)

  lcm_zoom <- rast(lcm_file) |> crop(vect(bbox_sfc))

  nfi_zoom <- st_crop(nfi_urban, bbox) |>
    st_collection_extract("POLYGON")
  nfi_raster <- rasterize(
    vect(nfi_zoom), lcm_zoom[[1]], field = 1, background = 0
  )

  classified <- lcm_zoom[[1]]
  classified[(lcm_zoom[[1]] %in% c(1, 2)) | (nfi_raster > 0)] <- 1

  resistance_full <- subst(
    classified,
    from = as.numeric(names(resistance_lookup)),
    to = as.numeric(resistance_lookup)
  )

  region_boundary_mask <- rasterize(region_vect, resistance_full, field = 1, background = 0)
  patch_mask_full <- (classified == 1) & (region_boundary_mask == 1)

  resistance <- mask(resistance_full, region_vect) |> trim()
  patch_mask <- mask(patch_mask_full, region_vect) |> trim()

  list(resistance = resistance, patch_mask = patch_mask, region = region)
}

fixed_thresholds <- c(59, 99, 512)

# Cluster-level area breakdown at a given threshold, used to derive the
# largest-cluster share and unweighted mean cluster size alongside ECS.
# Raw ECS is size-weighted and can be dominated by one supercluster (for
# example London at 512 m, where one dominant merged cluster drives ECS),
# so it does not represent a uniform city-wide result.
cluster_breakdown <- function(mpg, thresh, total_area_ha) {
  th <- threshold(mpg, doThresh = thresh)
  comp <- components(th$th[[1]])
  patch_area <- vertex_attr(mpg@mpg, "patchArea")
  cluster_area_ha <- tapply(patch_area, comp$membership, sum) / 10000
  list(
    n_clusters = comp$no,
    largest_cluster_share = max(cluster_area_ha) / total_area_ha,
    mean_cluster_size_ha = total_area_ha / comp$no
  )
}

# Direct component-based ECS at a single threshold, bypassing GOC(). It
# uses the same formula as GOC() (sum(cluster_area^2) / total_area),
# computed from threshold() and components() rather than from GOC's
# hierarchical-clustering summary table. It is the per-row fallback when
# GOC() returns NA, and also covers GOC() throwing a hard error (see
# build_region_mpg).
ecs_from_components <- function(mpg, thresh) {
  th <- threshold(mpg, doThresh = thresh)
  comp <- components(th$th[[1]])
  patch_area_m2 <- vertex_attr(mpg@mpg, "patchArea")
  cluster_area_m2 <- tapply(patch_area_m2, comp$membership, sum)
  ECS <- sum(cluster_area_m2^2) / sum(patch_area_m2)
  list(ECS = ECS, ECS_ha = ECS / 10000, nPolygon = comp$no)
}

build_region_mpg <- function(region_name) {
  built <- build_region_resistance(region_name)

  resistance_raster <- raster::raster(built$resistance)
  patch_raster <- raster::raster(built$patch_mask) == 1

  # Regions with no woodland patch cells within the boundary crash inside
  # MPG()'s own engine ("Engine did not initialize due to no initial
  # active cells found"), which surfaces several calls later as an opaque
  # "replacement has length zero". They are caught explicitly here, with
  # a stated reason.
  n_patch_cells <- sum(raster::values(patch_raster), na.rm = TRUE)
  if (n_patch_cells == 0) {
    stop("no woodland patch cells found within region boundary")
  }

  mpg <- MPG(cost = resistance_raster, patch = patch_raster)

  # GOC() can throw a hard error, not just return NA for a row, on graphs
  # too small for its hierarchical clustering to build a summary table
  # from. Typically MPG() is valid with exactly 2 patches and 1 link: a
  # genuine, non-empty network that GOC() cannot summarise. threshold()
  # and components() work on these graphs, so GOC() is bypassed and ECS is
  # computed from components. This is distinct from the "invalid class
  # 'hce'" failure, which is thrown inside MPG() itself before GOC() is
  # reached; there is no mpg object to fall back on in that case, so it
  # remains an uncaught failure.
  goc <- tryCatch(GOC(mpg, doThresh = fixed_thresholds), error = function(e) NULL)

  total_area_ha <- sum(vertex_attr(mpg@mpg, "patchArea")) / 10000

  # Computed before the ECS branch below because the consistency check
  # needs each threshold's largest_cluster_share.
  breakdown <- lapply(fixed_thresholds, cluster_breakdown, mpg = mpg, total_area_ha = total_area_ha)

  if (is.null(goc)) {
    ecs_rows <- lapply(fixed_thresholds, ecs_from_components, mpg = mpg)
    ecs_summary <- data.frame(
      ECS = vapply(ecs_rows, `[[`, numeric(1), "ECS"),
      ECS_ha = vapply(ecs_rows, `[[`, numeric(1), "ECS_ha"),
      nPolygon = vapply(ecs_rows, function(x) as.numeric(x$nPolygon), numeric(1))
    )
  } else {
    ecs_summary <- as.data.frame(goc@summary)
    ecs_summary$ECS_ha <- ecs_summary$ECS / 10000

    # GOC() returns NA whenever the requested threshold exceeds the
    # graph's maximum edge weight: the network has reached its final merge
    # state before the threshold, and GOC's windowing algorithm does not
    # handle "nothing left to merge". This is not only the single-cluster
    # case; a network can settle into several real components and GOC()
    # still returns NA. The fallback recomputes ECS from its definition
    # (sum(cluster_area^2) / total_area) for any component count. This is
    # the same formula, not a different one: with one component,
    # cluster_area equals total_area and the formula reduces to the
    # single-cluster case.
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(ecs_summary))) {
      if (is.na(ecs_summary$ECS[i])) {
        fb <- ecs_from_components(mpg, ecs_summary$maxLink[i])
        ecs_summary$ECS[i] <- fb$ECS
        ecs_summary$ECS_ha[i] <- fb$ECS_ha
        ecs_summary$nPolygon[i] <- fb$nPolygon
      }
    }

    # GOC() can also fail silently: it returns a value without NA but
    # reports cluster areas that are internally impossible. ECS is the sum
    # of squared cluster shares, so it can never be less than the largest
    # cluster's share squared. When ECS falls below that bound, GOC's area
    # accounting is wrong, and the same component-based fallback is used as
    # in the NA case. `national_loop_goc_consistency_fix` below applies
    # the same check to checkpoint rows computed before it existed.
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(ecs_summary))) {
      implied_min <- breakdown[[i]]$largest_cluster_share^2
      if ((ecs_summary$ECS_ha[i] / total_area_ha) < (implied_min - 0.01)) {
        fb <- ecs_from_components(mpg, fixed_thresholds[i])
        ecs_summary$ECS[i] <- fb$ECS
        ecs_summary$ECS_ha[i] <- fb$ECS_ha
        ecs_summary$nPolygon[i] <- fb$nPolygon
      }
    }
  }

  list(
    mpg = mpg, goc = goc, ecs_summary = ecs_summary,
    total_area_ha = total_area_ha, breakdown = breakdown, built = built,
    goc_bypassed = is.null(goc)
  )
}
```

# National loop

Computes ECS at 59, 99 and 512 m for every region, from the smallest to the largest, and saves the results to `08_national_ecs_results.csv` after each region. Regions already in that file are skipped, and a region that fails is logged and the loop moves on.

```{r national_loop}
results_path <- file.path(checkpoint_dir, "08_national_ecs_results.csv")

urban_regions_named$area_ha <- as.numeric(st_area(urban_regions_named)) / 10000
all_regions <- urban_regions_named |> arrange(area_ha) |> pull(bua_name) |> unique()

if (file.exists(results_path)) {
  prior <- read.csv(results_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  cat("Resuming: found", nrow(prior), "already-completed regions.\n")
  remaining <- setdiff(all_regions, prior$region)
} else {
  prior <- NULL
  remaining <- all_regions
}

cat("Regions remaining to process:", length(remaining), "of", length(all_regions), "\n\n")

row_names <- c(
  "region", "area_ha", "n_patches", "n_links", "total_area_ha",
  "ECS_ha_59", "nClusters_59", "ECS_pct_59", "largest_cluster_share_59", "mean_cluster_size_ha_59",
  "ECS_ha_99", "nClusters_99", "ECS_pct_99", "largest_cluster_share_99", "mean_cluster_size_ha_99",
  "ECS_ha_512", "nClusters_512", "ECS_pct_512", "largest_cluster_share_512", "mean_cluster_size_ha_512",
  "goc_bypassed", "error"
)

for (i in seq_along(remaining)) {
  rn <- remaining[i]
  area_ha <- urban_regions_named$area_ha[urban_regions_named$bua_name == rn][1]
  t0 <- Sys.time()

  res <- tryCatch({
    r <- build_region_mpg(rn)
    row <- data.frame(
      region = rn, area_ha = area_ha,
      n_patches = vcount(r$mpg@mpg), n_links = ecount(r$mpg@mpg),
      total_area_ha = r$total_area_ha
    )
    for (j in seq_along(fixed_thresholds)) {
      th <- fixed_thresholds[j]
      row[[paste0("ECS_ha_", th)]] <- r$ecs_summary$ECS_ha[j]
      row[[paste0("nClusters_", th)]] <- r$ecs_summary$nPolygon[j]
      row[[paste0("ECS_pct_", th)]] <- r$ecs_summary$ECS_ha[j] / r$total_area_ha
      row[[paste0("largest_cluster_share_", th)]] <- r$breakdown[[j]]$largest_cluster_share
      row[[paste0("mean_cluster_size_ha_", th)]] <- r$breakdown[[j]]$mean_cluster_size_ha
    }
    row$goc_bypassed <- r$goc_bypassed
    row$error <- NA
    row
  }, error = function(e) {
    row <- as.data.frame(setNames(as.list(rep(NA, length(row_names))), row_names))
    row$region <- rn
    row$area_ha <- area_ha
    row$error <- conditionMessage(e)
    row
  })

  elapsed <- round(as.numeric(Sys.time() - t0, units = "secs"), 1)
  status <- if (is.na(res$error)) "ok" else paste("FAILED:", res$error)
  cat(sprintf("[%d/%d] %s (%.1f ha) — %.1fs — %s\n", i, length(remaining), rn, area_ha, elapsed, status))

  # Append-and-rewrite: safe against interruption at any point, and cheap
  # at this number of rows and columns.
  combined <- if (is.null(prior)) res else bind_rows(prior, res)
  prior <- combined
  write.csv(combined, results_path, row.names = FALSE)
}

cat("\n=== NATIONAL RUN COMPLETE ===\n")
cat("Total regions:", nrow(prior), " — failures:", sum(!is.na(prior$error)), "\n")
```

## Repair of GOC() silent-failure regions in the checkpoint

`build_region_mpg()` above catches GOC() returning internally impossible
cluster areas (the consistency check in the ECS branch), so new runs of
`national_loop` correct themselves. `national_loop` is resumable and
skips any region already in `08_national_ecs_results.csv`, so rows
computed before that check existed would keep their bad values. This
chunk finds those rows using the same invariant (ECS_pct can never be
less than largest_cluster_share^2, at any threshold) and removes them, so
that `national_loop` recomputes them the next time it runs. When nothing
is broken it finds and removes 0 regions, so it is safe to re-run.

```{r national_loop_goc_consistency_fix}
prior <- read.csv(results_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
tol <- 0.01

find_violations <- function(df, pct_col, share_col) {
  sub <- df |> filter(!is.na(.data[[pct_col]]), !is.na(.data[[share_col]]))
  sub$region[sub[[pct_col]] < (sub[[share_col]]^2 - tol)]
}
bad_regions <- unique(c(
  find_violations(prior, "ECS_pct_59", "largest_cluster_share_59"),
  find_violations(prior, "ECS_pct_99", "largest_cluster_share_99"),
  find_violations(prior, "ECS_pct_512", "largest_cluster_share_512")
))
cat("Regions with an internally-inconsistent ECS value:", length(bad_regions), "\n")

if (length(bad_regions) > 0) {
  file.copy(results_path, sub("\\.csv$", "_BACKUP_before_goc_fix.csv", results_path), overwrite = FALSE)
  prior <- prior |> filter(!(region %in% bad_regions))
  write.csv(prior, results_path, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Removed from checkpoint; re-run the national_loop chunk above to recompute them",
      "with the now-fixed build_region_mpg().\n")
}
```

# Resistance-value sensitivity: Monte Carlo perturbation

Tests whether regional rankings depend on the resistance values assumed.
Every non-woodland resistance value is randomly perturbed by up to two
points and ECS is recomputed for a stratified sample of 20 regions (4
size groups x 5 regions, log-spaced by footprint area, seed 20260729,
excluding the four largest regions). Rank correlations with the
unperturbed baseline are calculated in
`analyse_resistance_sensitivity_512m` below.

```{r resistance_sensitivity_512m}
# Select the region sample
set.seed(20260729)

area_all <- urban_regions_named |>
  mutate(area_ha = as.numeric(sf::st_area(urban_regions_named)) / 10000) |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  arrange(desc(area_ha))

# The four largest regions are left out: they are by far the slowest to
# model, and 20 runs on each would not be practical.
mega <- head(area_all$bua_name, 4)
pool <- area_all |> filter(!bua_name %in% mega, area_ha > 0)

n_groups <- 4
breaks <- 10^seq(log10(min(pool$area_ha)), log10(max(pool$area_ha)), length.out = n_groups + 1)
pool$size_group <- cut(pool$area_ha, breaks = breaks, include.lowest = TRUE, labels = FALSE)

sensitivity_cities <- pool |>
  group_by(size_group) |>
  slice_sample(n = 5) |>
  ungroup() |>
  pull(bua_name)

cat("Reconstructed sensitivity sample (n =", length(sensitivity_cities), "):\n")
print(sensitivity_cities)

# Same as build_region_resistance() elsewhere, but takes the
# resistance lookup as an argument instead of using the global
# constant, so a perturbed version can be substituted per iteration.
build_region_resistance_p <- function(region_name, lookup) {
  region <- urban_regions_named |> filter(bua_name == region_name)
  bbox <- st_bbox(region)
  bbox_sfc <- st_as_sfc(bbox)
  region_vect <- vect(region)
  lcm_zoom <- rast(lcm_file) |> crop(vect(bbox_sfc))
  nfi_zoom <- st_crop(nfi_urban, bbox) |> st_collection_extract("POLYGON")
  nfi_raster <- rasterize(vect(nfi_zoom), lcm_zoom[[1]], field = 1, background = 0)
  classified <- lcm_zoom[[1]]
  classified[(lcm_zoom[[1]] %in% c(1, 2)) | (nfi_raster > 0)] <- 1
  resistance_full <- subst(classified, from = as.numeric(names(lookup)), to = as.numeric(lookup))
  region_boundary_mask <- rasterize(region_vect, resistance_full, field = 1, background = 0)
  patch_mask_full <- (classified == 1) & (region_boundary_mask == 1)
  resistance <- mask(resistance_full, region_vect) |> trim()
  patch_mask <- mask(patch_mask_full, region_vect) |> trim()
  list(resistance = resistance, patch_mask = patch_mask)
}

build_region_mpg_p <- function(region_name, lookup) {
  built <- build_region_resistance_p(region_name, lookup)
  resistance_raster <- raster::raster(built$resistance)
  patch_raster <- raster::raster(built$patch_mask) == 1
  mpg <- MPG(cost = resistance_raster, patch = patch_raster)

  # Same hard-error bypass as build_region_mpg(): a region whose graph is
  # too small for GOC()'s summary table falls back to component-based ECS
  # instead of failing.
  goc <- tryCatch(GOC(mpg, doThresh = fixed_thresholds), error = function(e) NULL)
  total_area_ha <- sum(vertex_attr(mpg@mpg, "patchArea")) / 10000
  breakdown <- lapply(fixed_thresholds, cluster_breakdown, mpg = mpg, total_area_ha = total_area_ha)

  if (is.null(goc)) {
    ecs_rows <- lapply(fixed_thresholds, ecs_from_components, mpg = mpg)
    ecs_summary <- data.frame(
      ECS = vapply(ecs_rows, `[[`, numeric(1), "ECS"),
      ECS_ha = vapply(ecs_rows, `[[`, numeric(1), "ECS_ha"),
      nPolygon = vapply(ecs_rows, function(x) as.numeric(x$nPolygon), numeric(1))
    )
  } else {
    ecs_summary <- as.data.frame(goc@summary)
    ecs_summary$ECS_ha <- ecs_summary$ECS / 10000

    for (i in seq_len(nrow(ecs_summary))) {
      if (is.na(ecs_summary$ECS[i])) {
        fb <- ecs_from_components(mpg, ecs_summary$maxLink[i])
        ecs_summary$ECS[i] <- fb$ECS
        ecs_summary$ECS_ha[i] <- fb$ECS_ha
        ecs_summary$nPolygon[i] <- fb$nPolygon
      }
    }

    # Same impossible-value consistency check as build_region_mpg(), so
    # this test uses the same ECS calculation as the national baseline.
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(ecs_summary))) {
      implied_min <- breakdown[[i]]$largest_cluster_share^2
      if ((ecs_summary$ECS_ha[i] / total_area_ha) < (implied_min - 0.01)) {
        fb <- ecs_from_components(mpg, fixed_thresholds[i])
        ecs_summary$ECS[i] <- fb$ECS
        ecs_summary$ECS_ha[i] <- fb$ECS_ha
        ecs_summary$nPolygon[i] <- fb$nPolygon
      }
    }
  }
  list(ecs_summary = ecs_summary, total_area_ha = total_area_ha)
}

# Perturb every class except woodland (class 1), which stays fixed at 1
# because the movement thresholds are defined in resistance units that
# equal metres for resistance-1 terrain; perturbing it would break that
# equivalence. Each other class shifts by a random integer in
# {-2, -1, 0, 1, 2}, clamped to the valid 1-10 range.
perturb_lookup <- function(base_lookup) {
  perturbed <- base_lookup
  non_woodland <- names(perturbed) != "1"
  shift <- sample(c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2), sum(non_woodland), replace = TRUE)
  perturbed[non_woodland] <- pmin(10, pmax(1, perturbed[non_woodland] + shift))
  perturbed
}

n_runs <- 20
resistance_sensitivity_path <- here::here("scripts", "sensitivity_analysis", "sensitivity_results_512m.csv")

# set.seed(20260729) was called above to select the region sample. It is
# not re-seeded here: the perturbation draws continue from the same RNG
# stream.

# Resumable: loads the runs already completed in full and skips them. The
# perturbation draw for a skipped run is still made, but not used, so the
# RNG state advances identically and a resumed run produces the same
# perturbations as one uninterrupted pass.
if (file.exists(resistance_sensitivity_path)) {
  prior <- read.csv(resistance_sensitivity_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  complete_runs <- prior |>
    count(run) |>
    filter(n == length(sensitivity_cities)) |>
    pull(run)
  prior <- prior |> filter(run %in% complete_runs)
  all_results <- if (nrow(prior) > 0) list(prior) else list()
  cat("Resuming: found", length(complete_runs), "complete run(s) already done.\n")
} else {
  complete_runs <- integer(0)
  all_results <- list()
}

# SENS_STOP_AFTER_RUN stops after that many runs, so the 20 runs can be
# done in small batches, each in a fresh R session (R can run out of
# memory over the full set). The resume logic above picks up where the
# last batch stopped.
stop_after_run <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("SENS_STOP_AFTER_RUN", unset = n_runs))

for (run in seq_len(n_runs)) {
  perturbed_lookup <- perturb_lookup(resistance_lookup)

  if (run > stop_after_run) break

  if (run %in% complete_runs) {
    cat("\n=== Run", run, "of", n_runs, "-- already complete, skipping ===\n")
    next
  }

  cat("\n=== Run", run, "of", n_runs, "===\n")

  for (city in sensitivity_cities) {
    t0 <- Sys.time()
    res <- tryCatch({
      r <- build_region_mpg_p(city, perturbed_lookup)
      row <- data.frame(run = run, region = city, total_area_ha = r$total_area_ha)
      for (j in seq_along(fixed_thresholds)) {
        th <- fixed_thresholds[j]
        row[[paste0("ECS_pct_", th)]] <- r$ecs_summary$ECS_ha[j] / r$total_area_ha
      }
      row$error <- NA
      row
    }, error = function(e) {
      data.frame(run = run, region = city, total_area_ha = NA,
                 ECS_pct_59 = NA, ECS_pct_99 = NA, ECS_pct_512 = NA,
                 error = conditionMessage(e))
    })
    elapsed <- round(as.numeric(Sys.time() - t0, units = "secs"), 1)
    status <- if (is.na(res$error)) "ok" else paste("FAILED:", res$error)
    mem_mb <- sum(gc()[, 2])
    cat(sprintf("  [%s] %.1fs %s (R memory %.0f MB)\n", city, elapsed, status, mem_mb))

    all_results[[length(all_results) + 1]] <- res
    write.csv(do.call(rbind, all_results), resistance_sensitivity_path, row.names = FALSE)
  }
}

cat("\n\n=== SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS (512m re-run) COMPLETE ===\n")
```

Rank correlation between each perturbed run and the unperturbed national
baseline, for the same sample of regions.

```{r analyse_resistance_sensitivity_512m}
s <- read.csv(resistance_sensitivity_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cat("Sensitivity rows:", nrow(s), "| runs:", length(unique(s$run)),
    "| failures:", sum(!is.na(s$error)), "\n")
s <- s |> filter(is.na(error))

# Baseline: the unperturbed national results for the same regions.
nat_baseline <- read.csv(file.path(checkpoint_dir, "08_national_ecs_results.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
sens_cities <- unique(s$region)
base <- nat_baseline |> filter(region %in% sens_cities, is.na(error)) |>
  dplyr::select(region, b59 = ECS_pct_59, b99 = ECS_pct_99, b512 = ECS_pct_512)
cat("Baseline cities matched:", nrow(base), "of", length(sens_cities), "\n\n")

res <- s |>
  inner_join(base, by = "region") |>
  group_by(run) |>
  summarise(
    rho_59  = cor(ECS_pct_59,  b59,  method = "spearman"),
    rho_99  = cor(ECS_pct_99,  b99,  method = "spearman"),
    rho_512 = cor(ECS_pct_512, b512, method = "spearman"),
    mad_59  = mean(abs(ECS_pct_59 - b59)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("=== Rank correlation with the unperturbed baseline, per run ===\n")
print(as.data.frame(res |> mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3)))), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n=== Summary across all", nrow(res), "perturbation runs ===\n")
for (th in c("59", "99", "512")) {
  v <- res[[paste0("rho_", th)]]
  cat(sprintf("  %sm: Spearman rho  mean = %.3f | min = %.3f | %% of runs >= 0.9 = %.0f%%\n",
              th, mean(v), min(v), 100 * mean(v >= 0.9)))
}
cat(sprintf("\n  Mean absolute change in ECS_pct at 59m: %.4f (baseline mean %.4f)\n",
            mean(res$mad_59), mean(base$b59)))

long <- res |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(starts_with("rho_"), names_to = "threshold", values_to = "rho") |>
  mutate(threshold = factor(gsub("rho_", "", threshold), levels = c("59", "99", "512"),
                            labels = c("59 m", "99 m", "512 m")))

p_resistance_sens <- ggplot(long, aes(x = threshold, y = rho, colour = threshold)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.9, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = NA, width = 0.5, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, size = 2.6, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(min(0.5, min(long$rho) - 0.05), 1.005)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("59 m" = "firebrick", "99 m" = "steelblue", "512 m" = "darkorange3"),
                      guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Results are robust to the resistance-value assumptions",
    subtitle = paste0("Each point is one of ", nrow(res), " Monte Carlo runs in which every non-woodland resistance value was\n",
                      "randomly shifted by up to ±2 points. Rank correlation is against the unperturbed baseline,\n",
                      "across a random size-stratified sample of ", length(sens_cities),
                      " urban regions. Dashed line = 0.9."),
    x = "Dispersal threshold", y = "Spearman rank correlation with baseline"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, lineheight = 1.2))

ggsave(here::here("figures", "sensitivity_resistance_values_512m.png"), p_resistance_sens, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

# Resistance-value sensitivity: targeted improved-grassland test

Companion to the Monte Carlo perturbation above. This holds every
resistance class fixed except improved grassland (class 4, a very
extensive class in urban areas and the most consequential parameter after
woodland itself), varying it across 2, 3 and 5 (5 is the baseline). It
uses the same 20-region sample as the Monte Carlo test (same seed and
exclusions).

```{r improved_grassland_test_512m}
build_region_resistance_gp <- function(region_name, lookup) {
  region <- urban_regions_named |> filter(bua_name == region_name)
  bbox <- st_bbox(region)
  bbox_sfc <- st_as_sfc(bbox)
  region_vect <- vect(region)
  lcm_zoom <- rast(lcm_file) |> crop(vect(bbox_sfc))
  nfi_zoom <- st_crop(nfi_urban, bbox) |> st_collection_extract("POLYGON")
  nfi_raster <- rasterize(vect(nfi_zoom), lcm_zoom[[1]], field = 1, background = 0)
  classified <- lcm_zoom[[1]]
  classified[(lcm_zoom[[1]] %in% c(1, 2)) | (nfi_raster > 0)] <- 1
  resistance_full <- subst(classified, from = as.numeric(names(lookup)), to = as.numeric(lookup))
  region_boundary_mask <- rasterize(region_vect, resistance_full, field = 1, background = 0)
  patch_mask_full <- (classified == 1) & (region_boundary_mask == 1)
  list(
    resistance = mask(resistance_full, region_vect) |> trim(),
    patch_mask = mask(patch_mask_full, region_vect) |> trim()
  )
}

build_region_mpg_gp <- function(region_name, lookup) {
  built <- build_region_resistance_gp(region_name, lookup)
  mpg <- MPG(cost = raster::raster(built$resistance),
             patch = raster::raster(built$patch_mask) == 1)

  # Same hard-error bypass as build_region_mpg(): a region whose graph is
  # too small for GOC()'s summary table falls back to component-based ECS
  # instead of failing.
  goc <- tryCatch(GOC(mpg, doThresh = fixed_thresholds), error = function(e) NULL)
  total_area_ha <- sum(vertex_attr(mpg@mpg, "patchArea")) / 10000
  breakdown <- lapply(fixed_thresholds, cluster_breakdown, mpg = mpg, total_area_ha = total_area_ha)

  if (is.null(goc)) {
    ecs_rows <- lapply(fixed_thresholds, ecs_from_components, mpg = mpg)
    ecs_summary <- data.frame(
      ECS = vapply(ecs_rows, `[[`, numeric(1), "ECS"),
      ECS_ha = vapply(ecs_rows, `[[`, numeric(1), "ECS_ha"),
      nPolygon = vapply(ecs_rows, function(x) as.numeric(x$nPolygon), numeric(1))
    )
  } else {
    ecs_summary <- as.data.frame(goc@summary)
    ecs_summary$ECS_ha <- ecs_summary$ECS / 10000

    for (i in seq_len(nrow(ecs_summary))) {
      if (is.na(ecs_summary$ECS[i])) {
        th <- threshold(mpg, doThresh = ecs_summary$maxLink[i])
        comp <- components(th$th[[1]])
        pa <- vertex_attr(mpg@mpg, "patchArea")
        ca <- tapply(pa, comp$membership, sum)
        ecs_summary$ECS[i] <- sum(ca^2) / sum(pa)
        ecs_summary$ECS_ha[i] <- ecs_summary$ECS[i] / 10000
        ecs_summary$nPolygon[i] <- comp$no
      }
    }

    # Same impossible-value consistency check as build_region_mpg(), so
    # this test uses the same ECS calculation as the national baseline.
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(ecs_summary))) {
      implied_min <- breakdown[[i]]$largest_cluster_share^2
      if ((ecs_summary$ECS_ha[i] / total_area_ha) < (implied_min - 0.01)) {
        fb <- ecs_from_components(mpg, fixed_thresholds[i])
        ecs_summary$ECS[i] <- fb$ECS
        ecs_summary$ECS_ha[i] <- fb$ECS_ha
        ecs_summary$nPolygon[i] <- fb$nPolygon
      }
    }
  }
  list(ecs_summary = ecs_summary, total_area_ha = total_area_ha)
}

# Targeted test: vary only improved grassland (class 4), holding every
# other class at its standard value. 5 is the baseline; 3 and 2 are lower
# values arguable for urban amenity mown grass (parks, verges, playing
# fields), which is what LCM class 4 mostly represents inside urban
# boundaries.
test_values <- c(2, 3, 5)
grassland_results_path <- here::here("scripts", "sensitivity_analysis", "improved_grassland_results_512m.csv")

if (file.exists(grassland_results_path)) {
  prior <- read.csv(grassland_results_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  all_grassland_results <- list(prior)
  done <- paste(prior$grassland_value, prior$region)
  cat("Resuming:", nrow(prior), "rows already done.\n")
} else {
  all_grassland_results <- list(); done <- character(0)
}

for (gv in test_values) {
  lookup <- resistance_lookup
  lookup["4"] <- gv
  cat("\n=== Improved grassland =", gv, "===\n")

  for (city in sensitivity_cities) {
    if (paste(gv, city) %in% done) { cat("  [", city, "] already done, skipping\n"); next }
    t0 <- Sys.time()
    res <- tryCatch({
      r <- build_region_mpg_gp(city, lookup)
      row <- data.frame(grassland_value = gv, region = city, total_area_ha = r$total_area_ha)
      for (j in seq_along(fixed_thresholds)) {
        th <- fixed_thresholds[j]
        row[[paste0("ECS_pct_", th)]] <- r$ecs_summary$ECS_ha[j] / r$total_area_ha
      }
      row$error <- NA
      row
    }, error = function(e) {
      data.frame(grassland_value = gv, region = city, total_area_ha = NA,
                 ECS_pct_59 = NA, ECS_pct_99 = NA, ECS_pct_512 = NA,
                 error = conditionMessage(e))
    })
    cat(sprintf("  [%s] %.1fs %s\n", city,
                round(as.numeric(Sys.time() - t0, units = "secs"), 1),
                if (is.na(res$error)) "ok" else paste("FAILED:", res$error)))
    all_grassland_results[[length(all_grassland_results) + 1]] <- res
    write.csv(do.call(rbind, all_grassland_results), grassland_results_path, row.names = FALSE)
  }
}

cat("\n=== IMPROVED GRASSLAND TEST (512m re-run) COMPLETE ===\n")

# Compare against the baseline (grassland = 5)
# dplyr::select() is qualified explicitly because an unqualified select()
# can clash with another package's select() (such as raster::select).
d_grassland <- do.call(rbind, all_grassland_results) |> filter(is.na(error))
base_grassland <- d_grassland |> filter(grassland_value == 5) |>
  dplyr::select(region, base_59 = ECS_pct_59, base_99 = ECS_pct_99, base_512 = ECS_pct_512)
for (gv in setdiff(test_values, 5)) {
  cmp <- d_grassland |> filter(grassland_value == gv) |> inner_join(base_grassland, by = "region")
  cat("\n--- Improved grassland =", gv, "vs baseline 5 ---\n")
  for (th in c("59", "99", "512")) {
    obs <- cmp[[paste0("ECS_pct_", th)]]; bas <- cmp[[paste0("base_", th)]]
    cat(sprintf("  %sm: Spearman rank r = %.3f | mean abs change in ECS_pct = %.4f (%.1f%% relative)\n",
                th, cor(obs, bas, method = "spearman"),
                mean(abs(obs - bas)), 100 * mean(abs(obs - bas) / pmax(bas, 1e-9))))
  }
}
```

# Threshold sensitivity: how much does the specific anchor species matter?

The thresholds are the minimum, median and maximum of seven comparable
species (59, 99 and 512 m; see `02b_Movement_Thresholds.Rmd`). This
checks robustness to which species ended up as the anchor at each tier:
would results look meaningfully different if a different, equally
defensible species from the same table had been the minimum, median or
maximum?

At the low end, Ringlet (59 m) is tested against the next-smallest,
Small White (67 m). At the high end, Brimstone (512 m) is tested against
the next-largest, Common Blue (228 m), a wide gap that matters because
Brimstone's value rests on a single study (n = 26), so this also checks
how much the upper threshold depends on that one data point. In the
middle, Meadow Brown (99 m, the median) is tested against its immediate
neighbours in the ranked list, Speckled Wood (73 m) and Marbled White
(111 m).

```{r threshold_sensitivity_new_anchors}
set.seed(20260814)

# A separate sample from the resistance test: 20 log-spaced size bands,
# one region drawn from each, again leaving out the four largest regions.
area_all2 <- urban_regions_named |>
  mutate(area_ha = as.numeric(sf::st_area(urban_regions_named)) / 10000) |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  arrange(desc(area_ha))

excluded_largest2 <- head(area_all2$bua_name, 4)
sample_pool2 <- area_all2 |> filter(!bua_name %in% excluded_largest2, area_ha > 0)

n_strata2 <- 20
strata_breaks2 <- 10^seq(log10(min(sample_pool2$area_ha)), log10(max(sample_pool2$area_ha)), length.out = n_strata2 + 1)
sample_pool2$stratum <- cut(sample_pool2$area_ha, breaks = strata_breaks2, include.lowest = TRUE, labels = FALSE)

sampled_regions2 <- sample_pool2 |>
  group_by(stratum) |>
  slice_sample(n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  pull(bua_name)

cat("Size-stratified sample:", length(sampled_regions2), "regions\n")

# 59 = Ringlet (chosen low),   67  = Small White (next-smallest)
# 73 = Speckled Wood,  99 = Meadow Brown (chosen mid),  111 = Marbled White
# 228 = Common Blue,  512 = Brimstone (chosen high)
anchor_thresholds <- c(59, 67, 73, 99, 111, 228, 512)

anchor_results <- list()
for (rn in sampled_regions2) {
  res <- tryCatch({
    built <- build_region_resistance(rn)
    resistance_raster <- raster::raster(built$resistance)
    patch_raster <- raster::raster(built$patch_mask) == 1
    n_patch_cells <- sum(raster::values(patch_raster), na.rm = TRUE)
    if (n_patch_cells == 0) stop("no woodland patch cells found within region boundary")
    mpg <- MPG(cost = resistance_raster, patch = patch_raster)
    total_area_ha <- sum(igraph::vertex_attr(mpg@mpg, "patchArea")) / 10000

    rows <- lapply(anchor_thresholds, function(th) {
      fb <- ecs_from_components(mpg, th)
      data.frame(region = rn, threshold = th, ECS_pct = fb$ECS_ha / total_area_ha, nClusters = fb$nPolygon)
    })
    do.call(rbind, rows)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("  skipped", rn, "--", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
    NULL
  })
  if (!is.null(res)) anchor_results[[rn]] <- res
}

anchor_df <- do.call(rbind, anchor_results)
cat("\nRegions successfully tested:", length(unique(anchor_df$region)), "of", length(sampled_regions2), "\n\n")

anchor_wide <- anchor_df |> tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = region, names_from = threshold, values_from = ECS_pct, names_prefix = "ECS_pct_")
print(anchor_wide)

cat("\n--- Would a different real candidate species at the same tier have changed region ranking? ---\n")
for (pair in list(c("low: 59 (Ringlet, chosen)", 59, "67 (Small White)", 67),
                   c("mid: 99 (Meadow Brown, chosen)", 99, "73 (Speckled Wood)", 73),
                   c("mid: 99 (Meadow Brown, chosen)", 99, "111 (Marbled White)", 111),
                   c("high: 512 (Brimstone, chosen)", 512, "228 (Common Blue)", 228))) {
  col_a <- paste0("ECS_pct_", pair[2])
  col_b <- paste0("ECS_pct_", pair[4])
  rho <- cor(anchor_wide[[col_a]], anchor_wide[[col_b]], method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
  cat(sprintf("Spearman rho, %s vs %s: %.3f\n", pair[1], pair[3], rho))
}
```

## Sensitivity summary table (Supplementary Table 5)

Collects the three sensitivity analyses into one table: the Spearman rank
correlation of region rankings with the baseline (resistance tests) or with
the focal-threshold ranking (movement-threshold test). The resistance results
are read from the two saved result files, so the table reflects the current
runs. Writes `figures/SuppTable5_sensitivity_summary.csv`.

```{r results_supp_table5_sensitivity_summary}
figures_dir <- here::here("figures")
mc_sens <- read.csv(here::here("scripts", "sensitivity_analysis", "sensitivity_results_512m.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
gr_sens <- read.csv(here::here("scripts", "sensitivity_analysis", "improved_grassland_results_512m.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
nat_base <- read.csv(file.path(checkpoint_dir, "08_national_ecs_results.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

base_mc <- nat_base |> filter(region %in% unique(mc_sens$region), is.na(error)) |>
  dplyr::select(region, b59 = ECS_pct_59, b99 = ECS_pct_99, b512 = ECS_pct_512)

mc_rho <- mc_sens |> filter(is.na(error)) |> inner_join(base_mc, by = "region") |>
  group_by(run) |>
  summarise(r59 = cor(ECS_pct_59, b59, method = "spearman"),
            r99 = cor(ECS_pct_99, b99, method = "spearman"),
            r512 = cor(ECS_pct_512, b512, method = "spearman"), .groups = "drop")

fmt <- function(x) sprintf("%.3f", x)
n_runs <- nrow(mc_rho)

grass_rho <- function(value) {
  base5 <- gr_sens |> filter(grassland_value == 5, is.na(error))
  x <- gr_sens |> filter(grassland_value == value, is.na(error)) |>
    inner_join(base5 |> dplyr::select(region, b59 = ECS_pct_59, b99 = ECS_pct_99, b512 = ECS_pct_512), by = "region")
  c(cor(x$ECS_pct_59, x$b59, method = "spearman"), cor(x$ECS_pct_99, x$b99, method = "spearman"),
    cor(x$ECS_pct_512, x$b512, method = "spearman"))
}
g3 <- grass_rho(3); g2 <- grass_rho(2)

sp <- function(a, b) cor(anchor_wide[[paste0("ECS_pct_", a)]], anchor_wide[[paste0("ECS_pct_", b)]],
                         method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")

sens_table <- data.frame(
  Test = c(
    paste0("Resistance perturbation (", n_runs, " runs): mean correlation with baseline"),
    paste0("Resistance perturbation (", n_runs, " runs): minimum correlation"),
    paste0("Resistance perturbation (", n_runs, " runs): runs with correlation of at least 0.9"),
    "Improved grassland resistance 3 (baseline 5): correlation with baseline",
    "Improved grassland resistance 2 (baseline 5): correlation with baseline",
    "Alternative movement estimate: 59 m (Ringlet) against 67 m (Small White)",
    "Alternative movement estimate: 99 m (Meadow Brown) against 73 m (Speckled Wood)",
    "Alternative movement estimate: 99 m (Meadow Brown) against 111 m (Marbled White)",
    "Alternative movement estimate: 512 m (Brimstone) against 228 m (Common Blue)"),
  `59 m`  = c(fmt(mean(mc_rho$r59)), fmt(min(mc_rho$r59)), paste0(sum(mc_rho$r59 >= 0.9), "/", n_runs), fmt(g3[1]), fmt(g2[1]), fmt(sp(59, 67)), "", "", ""),
  `99 m`  = c(fmt(mean(mc_rho$r99)), fmt(min(mc_rho$r99)), paste0(sum(mc_rho$r99 >= 0.9), "/", n_runs), fmt(g3[2]), fmt(g2[2]), "", fmt(sp(99, 73)), fmt(sp(99, 111)), ""),
  `512 m` = c(fmt(mean(mc_rho$r512)), fmt(min(mc_rho$r512)), paste0(sum(mc_rho$r512 >= 0.9), "/", n_runs), fmt(g3[3]), fmt(g2[3]), "", "", "", fmt(sp(512, 228))),
  check.names = FALSE
)
print(sens_table, row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(sens_table, file.path(figures_dir, "SuppTable5_sensitivity_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Threshold sweep: connectivity at every 10 m threshold, separate from the national loop above

A standalone analysis that does not modify `build_functions` or
`national_loop` and does not touch `08_national_ecs_results.csv`. It
writes a second file, `08_national_ecs_threshold_sweep.csv`, with a
connectivity curve per region (every 10 m, 0 to 500 m here and extended
to 1,000 m below), so connectivity can be looked up for any movement
threshold, not just the three focal values (59, 99 and 512 m).

It calls `build_region_mpg()` unchanged to get each region's MPG (which
also recomputes the 59, 99 and 512 m values; those are discarded here).
It is resumable like the main loop but tracked against its own file.

```{r threshold_sweep_functions}
sweep_thresholds <- seq(0, 500, by = 10)

compute_threshold_sweep <- function(mpg, thresholds, total_area_ha) {
  goc <- tryCatch(GOC(mpg, doThresh = thresholds), error = function(e) NULL)

  if (is.null(goc)) {
    ecs_rows <- lapply(thresholds, ecs_from_components, mpg = mpg)
    ecs_ha <- vapply(ecs_rows, `[[`, numeric(1), "ECS_ha")
    n_polygon <- vapply(ecs_rows, function(x) as.numeric(x$nPolygon), numeric(1))
  } else {
    ecs_summary <- as.data.frame(goc@summary)
    ecs_ha <- ecs_summary$ECS / 10000
    n_polygon <- ecs_summary$nPolygon
    for (i in seq_along(thresholds)) {
      if (is.na(ecs_ha[i])) {
        fb <- ecs_from_components(mpg, thresholds[i])
        ecs_ha[i] <- fb$ECS_ha
        n_polygon[i] <- fb$nPolygon
      }
    }
  }

  breakdown <- lapply(thresholds, cluster_breakdown, mpg = mpg, total_area_ha = total_area_ha)

  data.frame(
    threshold_m = thresholds,
    ECS_ha = ecs_ha,
    ECS_pct = ecs_ha / total_area_ha,
    nClusters = n_polygon,
    largest_cluster_share = vapply(breakdown, function(x) x$largest_cluster_share, numeric(1)),
    mean_cluster_size_ha = vapply(breakdown, function(x) x$mean_cluster_size_ha, numeric(1))
  )
}
```

Computes ECS at every 10 m threshold from 0 to 500 m for each region not yet in `08_national_ecs_threshold_sweep.csv`, and appends the results to that file after each region.

```{r threshold_sweep_loop}
sweep_results_path <- file.path(checkpoint_dir, "08_national_ecs_threshold_sweep.csv")

if (file.exists(sweep_results_path)) {
  prior_sweep <- read.csv(sweep_results_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  cat("Resuming: found", length(unique(prior_sweep$region)), "regions already swept.\n")
  remaining_sweep <- setdiff(all_regions, unique(prior_sweep$region))
} else {
  prior_sweep <- NULL
  remaining_sweep <- all_regions
}

cat("Regions remaining for threshold sweep:", length(remaining_sweep), "of", length(all_regions), "\n\n")

for (i in seq_along(remaining_sweep)) {
  rn <- remaining_sweep[i]
  area_ha <- urban_regions_named$area_ha[urban_regions_named$bua_name == rn][1]
  t0 <- Sys.time()

  sweep_row <- tryCatch({
    r <- build_region_mpg(rn)
    row <- compute_threshold_sweep(r$mpg, sweep_thresholds, r$total_area_ha)
    row$region <- rn
    row
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("  skipped", rn, "--", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
    NULL
  })

  elapsed <- round(as.numeric(Sys.time() - t0, units = "secs"), 1)
  status <- if (is.null(sweep_row)) "FAILED" else "ok"
  cat(sprintf("[%d/%d] %s (%.1f ha) — %.1fs — %s\n", i, length(remaining_sweep), rn, area_ha, elapsed, status))

  if (!is.null(sweep_row)) {
    prior_sweep <- if (is.null(prior_sweep)) sweep_row else bind_rows(prior_sweep, sweep_row)
    write.csv(prior_sweep, sweep_results_path, row.names = FALSE)
  }
}

cat("\n=== THRESHOLD SWEEP COMPLETE ===\n")
cat("Regions swept:", length(unique(prior_sweep$region)), "of", length(all_regions), "\n")
```

## Extend the sweep to 1,000 m

The 0-500 m sweep above had not levelled off by 500 m, so this extends
the range to 1,000 m. The existing 0-500 m results in
`08_national_ecs_threshold_sweep.csv` are kept, and the new rows for
510-1,000 m are appended to the same file. Each region's MPG still has to
be rebuilt from scratch (only summary numbers were saved, not the graph),
so this takes about as long as the original 0-500 m run.

Resumable and tracked separately from the 0-500 m run: a region is
skipped only once it has a row at 1,000 m, not merely because it appears
in the file.

```{r threshold_sweep_extend_loop}
extended_thresholds <- seq(510, 1000, by = 10)

if (!file.exists(sweep_results_path)) {
  stop("08_national_ecs_threshold_sweep.csv not found -- run threshold_sweep_loop (0-500m) first.")
}
prior_sweep <- read.csv(sweep_results_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

regions_already_extended <- prior_sweep |> filter(threshold_m >= 1000) |> pull(region) |> unique()
remaining_extend <- setdiff(all_regions, regions_already_extended)

cat("Regions already extended to 1000m:", length(regions_already_extended), "\n")
cat("Regions remaining for the 510-1000m extension:", length(remaining_extend), "of", length(all_regions), "\n\n")

for (i in seq_along(remaining_extend)) {
  rn <- remaining_extend[i]
  area_ha <- urban_regions_named$area_ha[urban_regions_named$bua_name == rn][1]
  t0 <- Sys.time()

  sweep_row <- tryCatch({
    r <- build_region_mpg(rn)
    row <- compute_threshold_sweep(r$mpg, extended_thresholds, r$total_area_ha)
    row$region <- rn
    row
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("  skipped", rn, "--", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
    NULL
  })

  elapsed <- round(as.numeric(Sys.time() - t0, units = "secs"), 1)
  status <- if (is.null(sweep_row)) "FAILED" else "ok"
  cat(sprintf("[%d/%d] %s (%.1f ha) — %.1fs — %s\n", i, length(remaining_extend), rn, area_ha, elapsed, status))

  if (!is.null(sweep_row)) {
    prior_sweep <- bind_rows(prior_sweep, sweep_row)
    write.csv(prior_sweep, sweep_results_path, row.names = FALSE)
  }
}

cat("\n=== EXTENSION TO 1000m COMPLETE ===\n")
cat("Regions at 1000m:", length(unique(prior_sweep$region[prior_sweep$threshold_m >= 1000])), "of", length(all_regions), "\n")
```
